text.offer: Widow Qesino says, "You've come a long way to reach Jasper, dear. Don't do it twice. There's a portal in the west of town. Walk into it and it will remember you, and then Jasper is only a step from any other portal you've touched."
text.complete: Widow Qesino says, "That's it. Now you've no excuse not to visit an old woman now and then."

steps.brief: Jasper's travel portal is in the west of town (a gold "!" marks portals you haven't touched). Walk into it to attune yourself to it.
